name: CargoAi
description: Browse rates and track air cargo directly from Claude. Make CargoAi a native part of your AI workflow — an AI-powered freight agent that helps forwarders get instant quotes and monitor shipments faster, with less friction. Bring your CargoMart operations into the conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CargoAi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CargoAi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.cargoai.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CargoAi MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CargoAi provides these MCP tools: track_shipment, search_rates, airline_contact, gha_information, subscribe_shipment, and unsubscribe_shipment.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CargoAi?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CargoAi in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
CargoAi requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CargoAi is developed by CargoAi. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
